# LibreOffice Impress GUI Interface Description

## System and Application Header

- **Operating System Environment**: Linux desktop environment, as indicated by the "Activities" button in the top-left corner.
- **Application Title Bar**: 
  - Displays "LibreOffice Impress" as the active application.
  - File name: "campaign_slides.pptx"
  - Current date and time: "Oct 22 19:31"
  - System status icons: bell (notifications), sound, and power buttons on the top-right.

## Desktop Environment and Application Icons

- **Left Sidebar (Application Launcher)**:
  - **Activities**: Grid icon at the bottom-left.
  - **Application Icons (Top to Bottom)**:
    - Google Chrome (browser)
    - Thunderbird (email client)
    - Visual Studio Code (code editor)
    - VLC Media Player (media player)
    - LibreOffice Writer (word processor)
    - LibreOffice Calc (spreadsheet)
    - LibreOffice Impress (current application)
    - GIMP (image editor)
    - File Manager (folder icon)
    - Ubuntu Software (store icon)
    - Help (question mark icon)
    - Trash (recycle bin icon)

## LibreOffice Impress Menu and Toolbar

- **Menu Bar**:
  - Standard menu options: File, Edit, View, Insert, Format, Slide, Slide Show, Tools, Window, Help.
- **Toolbar**:
  - Contains icons for common actions:
    - File operations (New, Open, Save, Print)
    - Edit operations (Cut, Copy, Paste)
    - Slide operations (New Slide, Duplicate Slide, Delete Slide)
    - Drawing tools (Shapes, Lines, Arrows, Text Box, Callouts, Stars, etc.)
    - Formatting tools (Font, Size, Bold, Italic, Underline, Strikethrough, Text Color, Font Color, Font Size Increase/Decrease)
    - Special characters (Omega, Superscript, Subscript)
    - Object manipulation (Link, Pen, Shape, Text Box, etc.)
    - Slide layout and transition tools

## Slide Navigation Panel

- **Location**: Left side of the interface.
- **Content**:
  - Slide thumbnails for 6 slides.
  - Slide 1: Title slide with text "Eradicating Heritable Disorders Through Prenatal Genetic Testing" and a large white arrow graphic.
  - Slides 2-5: Identical thumbnails with a large white arrow graphic on a yellow background.
  - Slide 6: Currently selected, highlighted with a brown border.
  - Slide 6 thumbnail shows a yellow background with a large white arrow graphic.
  - Slide 6 is the active slide, as indicated by the highlighted border and the status bar.

## Main Slide Editing Area

- **Current Slide**: Slide 6.
- **Background**: Solid yellow.
- **Graphic Element**: A large white arrow pointing diagonally from the bottom-left to the top-right.
- **Text Box**:
  - Located in the upper-left portion of the slide.
  - Placeholder text: "Click to add Text".
  - Text box is outlined with a dashed orange border, indicating it is selected and ready for editing.
  - Text is formatted with a bullet point.

## Properties Panel

- **Location**: Right side of the interface.
- **Panel Sections**:
  - **Character**:
    - Font: "Arial"
    - Font Size: "14 pt"
    - Font Style Buttons: Bold (B), Italic (I), Underline (U), Strikethrough (S), Superscript (A), Subscript (A)
    - Text Color: Dropdown with color swatch

    - Font Size Increase/Decrease: A+ and A- buttons
    - Font Size Adjustment: "14 pt" input field

    - Toggle Unordered List: Button with tooltip "Toggle Unordered List"
    - List Style Options: Various bullet and numbering styles (discs, squares, arrows, checkmarks, etc.)
    - More Bullets...: Button to access additional list styles
    - List Indentation: "0.00 cm" input field with up/down arrows for adjustment
